# MECHANISM: Use a modified logarithmic function with a softening factor to prioritize bins based on remaining capacity.

def priority(item, bins):
    capacity = 150
    softening_factor = 10
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = -np.log(remaining_capacity[valid_bins] / (capacity - item + softening_factor))
    priority_scores[~valid_bins] = -np.inf
    return priority_scores
